'''Varos''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Varos grew in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world's warm tropic region, and were known for their velvety aroma when ripe. They were among one of many varied fruits that [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] used to distill the [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage ''[[Tihaar/Legends|tihaar]]''.<ref name="ImpCom" />

The Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] enjoyed both the smell of varos, and the blend of ''tihaar'' that could be distilled from the fruit. Due to their growth in Mandalore's tropic region, Skirata viewed finding varos-distilled ''tihaar'' in the northern reaches of the planet to be a rare treat.<ref name="ImpCom" />

==Behind the scenes==
Varos fruit was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe via a mention in ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', the fifth entry into the [[Republic Commando|''Republic'' and ''Imperial Commando'' series]] of novels [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Karen Traviss]], published [[October 27]], [[2009]].
